raw.title: Business Development Lead
raw.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Business Development Lead

As our Business Development Lead for the North, you will act as a high-impact player-coach leading our mid-market SME sales strategy across primary care networks, GP practices, and federations. You’ll balance hands-on selling and revenue generation with building and coaching a high-performing outbound sales team as we launch exciting new products across the region.

Please note: while this role is based in London, travel throughout the North of England will be required.

  • Building an outbound sales machine: Establishing structured, high-volume mass cadences and buyer-signal-based strategies to scale mid-market SME adoption across the North

  • Leading as a player-coach: Closing your own key target deals while setting direction, coaching, and developing a team of BDAs and BDMs to hit team revenue targets

  • Driving new product growth: Unlocking expansion opportunities across our growing product suite, including Scribe. There's a things we can't talk about yet, but they are set to revolutionise the way care is delivered in Primary care

  • Data-driven market mapping: Utilising platforms, complex datasets, and spreadsheets to analyse market opportunities, forecast pipelines, and convert data into clear commercial priorities

  • Ground-level user engagement: Attending webinars, regional events, and speaking directly with primary care stakeholders to stay close to market needs and lead by example

  • Leveraging cutting-edge AI tools: Integrating AI tooling (such as Notion AI) into your team's workflow to capture customer insights, refine audience segmentation, and automate sequence tasks so your team spends more time with users.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partnering closely with marketing, the wider BD team and our Customer Success team to drive seamless deal conversion and wider regional growth

You should apply if...

  • You're a proven sales expert: You are an established salesperson with a background in traditional sales (e.g., SDR, AE, or Sales Manager) who has carried a revenue target and knows what it takes to hit it consistently

  • You're passionate about people & leading them: You have some experience managing, mentoring, or coaching salespeople, with a passion for holding team members accountable and coaching them to high performance

  • You have high-velocity outbound expertise: You have hands-on experience running structured outbound cadences, converting high-volume pipelines, and executing mid-market sales motions at scale

  • You're fluent in data: You are highly proficient with spreadsheets, platforms, and complex data sets, able to turn raw figures into clear operational decisions and compelling customer pitches

  • You know how to forecast: You possess strong target-setting and pipeline forecasting capability, bringing commercial clarity to your team’s plan

  • You thrive in pace and getting stuff done: You bring a driver mindset, moving with urgency and resourcefulness to build repeatable processes in a fast-changing startup environment.

  • You know healthcare or the public sector experience: You have experience selling into the NHS, primary care networks, or complex public sector and policy environments

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

  • £75,000 - £95,000 salary + share options up to £30,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Compensation: £75K – £95K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Principal Engineer
raw.description:
At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
 
The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.
 
Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
 
Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
 
It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

The Ideal Candidate
 
We are looking for a top-notch Principal Software Engineer to join the Bazaarvoice team in Belfast, UK. We are big believers in teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
 
The ideal candidate is self-motivated, extremely curious, a strong communicator, patient, and highly enthusiastic about driving cross-team collaboration to meet our growth objectives.
Beyond designing and implementing traditional distributed, fault-tolerant systems, you will be a visionary champion leading our agentic transformation. This means you will fundamentally shift our engineering culture and architecture from a paradigm of engineers writing manual code to an advanced model where engineers design, orchestrate, and manage autonomous AI agents.
 
 

Requirements and Responsibilities:
  • Agentic Transformation Leadership: Spearhead the transition from traditional code generation to agentic workflows. Define the architecture, guardrails, and patterns for how engineers build and manage AI agents to automate and scale our development lifecycle.
  • Individual Contributor: Remain hands-on and able to code, build prototypes, and architect agent workflows as needed.
  • Technical Ownership: Assume technical ownership of the security, quality, scale, and performance of products delivered from our Belfast hub (collaborating closely with our global engineering teams).
  • Cloud Architecture: Oversee architectures, designs, and delivery of products built and deployed on AWS.
  • Global Influence: Actively influence architectures, designs, and standards for the global product development team.
  • Innovation & Roadmaps: Champion innovation and continuous improvements across the engineering organization , identifying and creating technology roadmaps that lean heavily into AI and automation.
  • Prototyping: Develop prototypes and proofs-of-concept in support of AI/agentic technology recommendations.
  • Talent & Mentorship: Assist in recruiting and hiring top talent per organizational needs , while guiding, mentoring, and evaluating highly capable technical talent to prepare them for an agent-driven ecosystem.

    • Required Skills:
  • 15+ years of overall relevant software engineering experience, with 8+ years specifically within world-class product companies.
  • Full-Stack Capabilities: 10+ years of strong full-stack software development experience.
  • SaaS Architecture: 5+ years of experience architecting, designing, and building high-scale, high-performance SaaS products.
  • Cloud Expertise: 5+ years of cloud experience.
  • Agentic & AI Vision: Proven understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks (e.g., Claude Code, LangChain, custom agent orchestration), with a clear vision of how to shift engineering from manual coding to agent management.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and influencing skills across multiple geographic locations , alongside a proven track record of cross-functional collaboration.

    • Nice to Haves:
  • Exposure to Big Data environments – data processing / analytics.
  • Experience working  within the Ecommerce space.
    • #LI-EM1

    Why join Bazaarvoice?
     
    Customer is key
    We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.  
    We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.
     
    Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust
    We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA. 
    We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance.
     
    Passionate Pursuit of Performance
    Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity. 
    We love what we do, and because we’re laser focused on our mission.
     
    Innovation over Imitation
    We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo. 
    We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage.
     
    Stronger Together
    We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives. 
    We champion what’s best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams.  
    As a stronger company we build a stronger community.
     
     
    Want to see our culture in action? Explore our global Linkedin Life Page, Life at Bazaarvoice to see the bigger picture, or visit our EMEA Life Page to meet our regional teams and see what life is like in our local offices.  
     
     
     
    Commitment to diversity and inclusion
     Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world’s smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers.
     
     
    Please note: The successful candidate will be required to undergo a basic AccessNI check prior to starting.

raw.description:
Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx.

I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies.

Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work.

We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business.

Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the People team

Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.

Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.

You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..

What you'll be doing

  • Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side.

  • Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

  • Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves.

  • Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort.

  • Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person.

  • Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project.

  • Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you.

  • Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for.

  • Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend.

  • Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role.

  • Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information.

  • Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You struggle to adapt to change or ambiguity, or find it difficult to collaborate across diverse teams.

  • You're not energised by a culture that values ownership, feedback, and continuous learning.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off and learn more about your background.

  2. Manager interview with our People Lead to explore your experience in more depth.

  3. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team.

  4. Values interview to get to know how you work and how that aligns with hx's culture with our VP of People and Senior Director of Finance and Operations.

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Check out our blog at Insights & Blog - hyperexponential

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Your mission

Native designs products that get made. Since 1997 we've worked across the US, Europe and Asia for the companies that take the object seriously: Bowers & Wilkins, Bang & Olufsen, Audi, Coloplast, Baxter, Bentley, HP and others we can't name yet. Along the way we've collected more international design awards than any independent studio in Europe. We've turned down every offer to be acquired because independence is what lets us tell a client the truth.
 
We're looking for a passionate, collaborative and creative Senior UI Designer with an impeccable eye for beauty, a head full of ideas and a strong sense of creative direction to join our studio in Shoreditch. We're hired to create wholly new products and experiences, so we're as much inventors as designers.
 
As a Senior UI Designer, you'll help define the future of our digital output, shaping remarkable experiences across tech, healthcare, wellness and automotive. You'll set visual design direction and deliver excellence across many platforms - from multi-modal AI experiences, beautiful UI, emotionally engaging motion design and 3D prototypes. You'll take ownership of creative output, grow into a mentorship role, and have a genuine influence on how the studio evolves.
 
You'll work with some of the world's best designers, developers, anthropologists, strategists, and engineers to make work that pushes boundaries, challenges perceptions, and - occasionally - changes the world.


Your profile

You
Here’s an idea of the sort of Senior UI Designer we hope is reading this: 

  • Experienced & Agency-Tested: You’ve honed your skills in a fast-paced, creative, (product, advertising, marketing or branding) agency environment, where you’ve delivered high-impact work across a range of industries.
  • Storyteller: You don’t just design, you shape narratives. You can articulate the thinking behind your work in a way that resonates with clients, teams, and users alike.
  • AI proficient: You actively explore new AI tools and thoughtfully integrate them into your workflow - not for novelty, but to elevate speed, craft, and thinking.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Fluent: You understand 3D and motion – bridging the gap between tactile and digital.
  • Visionary Thinker: You are full of ideas and bring creative thinking and technological curiosity to every challenge. You push what’s possible and influence others to do the same.
  • Leadership Minded: You're ready to step into a bigger role. You naturally guide more junior designers, earn trust across disciplines, and think about the craft at a studio level not just project level.
  • Craft-Led: You're obsessive about typography, hierarchy, layout, and interaction, with an eye for flawless visual execution.
  • Adaptable: We're not afraid to scrap an idea. Sometimes, we build it, test it, and start again. If this doesn't fill you with dread, and you're excited by the idea of being the person who helps shape what comes next, you'll make the work of your life at Native
  • Passionate: A passion for what you do is essential. We believe the best creatives genuinely enjoy their work.


Why us?

Us
Here's what you can expect from us:

  • Annual Leave 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays. We actively encourage you to take your leave.
  • Enhanced Parental Leave Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
  • Private Healthcare Bupa private medical insurance, including 24/7 GP access, mental health support, and specialist care. A health and wellness cashback plan.
  • Wellbeing & Fitness 40% discount across the Hussle Gym network. Access to YuLife wellbeing and fitness benefits, including mindfulness resources, company-wide challenges and cash rewards.
  • Professional Development Opportunities for learning and development, access to industry talks, exhibitions, and visiting speakers.
  • Studio Culture Regular company events and studio activities throughout the year.
  • Location Our Shoreditch studio is well connected and surrounded by a vibrant design and technology community.
  • Independent Studio Native has operated independently in East London for almost 30 years. We are committed to long-term thinking, craft, and delivering thoughtful innovation without compromise.

We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.


What You Will Do
  • Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and development of systems that enable and enhance partner and platform experiences across devices and integrations
  • Drive complex technical initiatives that span multiple studios or a full mission — particularly where coordination cost, architectural sprawl, or competing local optimizations are part of the problem
  • Create leverage by unifying fragmented approaches, retiring duplicative systems, and establishing the standards and platforms that enable multiple studios move faster without reinventing foundations — judging where consolidation creates leverage and where local autonomy is the better choice
  • Define and influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries and bring other senior engineers along in executing it
  • Collaborate with engineering, product and design leaders across the Experience Mission and beyond to identify shared opportunities, align technical direction and reduce duplication
  • Shape how AI transforms the software development lifecycle and pioneer AI-native workflows and capabilities that bridge engineering, product, and design

    • Who You Are
  • You have deep experience designing, building and operating distributed systems that serve users at scale
  • You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built
  • You thrive in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and can identify where technical investment will create the greatest leverage across teams and systems
  • You care deeply about reliable, high-quality user experiences powered by data and personalization
  • You actively explore how AI reshapes how we build, not just what we build, and can turn emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how teams work
  • You bring a thoughtful, collaborative, inclusive mindset and actively contribute to a positive team culture

    • Where You Will Be
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. For this role, you can be based anywhere in EMEA where Spotify has a work location (excluding France due to on-call restrictions).

Lead the marketing engine behind some of the world's most iconic mobile games.

We’re looking for a Head of Performance Marketing to join Supercell – someone who combines strategic capability and clarity, technical depth, and people-first leadership. You’ll lead our Performance Marketing function, including world-class Performance Marketing teams, ASO, and CRM, driving growth for some of the world’s most iconic mobile games while enabling a talented team to do their best work.

You’ll be deeply embedded in the business by balancing creative ambition with operational excellence, and turning data, technology, and insight into growth.

You will lead a talented team responsible for driving user acquisition and cross-media operations across Supercell’s live and future games. Our Performance Marketing team operates both centrally and embedded within game teams – you’ll need to set direction and enable success across both models, building the systems and culture that empower the team wherever they sit.

This is a role for someone who leads with clarity and empathy, sees the bigger picture without losing sight of impact, and navigates complex organizations with diplomacy and confidence. You’ll partner closely with leaders and teams across Game teams, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Finance, and Creative Production to ensure our media strategies drive long-term growth and business impact.

We pride ourselves on the level of thoughtfulness, quality, and focus put into every aspect of our work. Be it the games themselves or how we communicate them to our players, we are passionate about not compromising on quality ever and choosing a long-term approach to make Supercell a truly global games company that will last for many decades to come.

Let us know if you are who we are looking for!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Shape the strategic vision and direction for Supercell’s Performance Marketing function, ensuring alignment with company and game-level business goals. Drive cross-functional alignment through openness, integrity, and collaboration – ensuring clarity of direction across marketing, analytics, and operations.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Performance Marketing, ASO, and CRM professionals; setting clear goals, fostering autonomy, and creating an environment where people do their best work.

  • Build and maintain measurement frameworks, governance structures, and operational systems that enable the team to perform at their best, alongside coaching and culture that help individuals grow.

  • Build strong partnerships with Game Leads, Marketing Leads, Data, and Finance to ensure marketing investment decisions are data-informed, scalable, and business-driven.

  • Oversee media strategy and governance – ensuring that Supercell’s global marketing efforts are effective, efficient, and future-proofed against evolving market dynamics.

  • Own CRM as a strategic growth lever – ensuring lifecycle and retention strategy is tightly integrated with user acquisition, game-level priorities, and long-term business goals.

  • Embrace AI curiosity and capability – comfortable working with AI-powered campaign tools and platforms, you understand how algorithms make decisions and how to work with them, not just around them. This includes using AI for workflow automation, creative production, and campaign optimization, while staying honest about the trade-offs involved.

  • Push boundaries. Take bold bets. Own risks and back your team when it counts.

What you have

  • Extensive leadership experience in performance marketing and media or operations with a proven track record of leading high-impact, high-scale teams in complex, global organizations.

  • Deep understanding of performance marketing and user acquisition, with the ability to translate complex technical and data-driven concepts into strategic direction. This includes a strong grasp of product dynamics and the interaction between UA and product – understanding how marketing decisions shape and are shaped by the player experience and game economy.

  • Player-first mindset. You believe great marketing ultimately serves the player experience, not just the metrics.

  • Portfolio-level experience managing marketing investment across multiple products at different lifecycle stages, with the ability to allocate, prioritize, and adapt strategy as games grow, mature, or launch.

  • Strong business and financial mindset, able to connect marketing performance to commercial outcomes and broader company goals.

  • Fluent in data and analytics, with the ability to guide strategic decision-making in collaboration with data science and analytics teams.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing senior leaders and aligning diverse perspectives around shared priorities.

  • Diplomatic and emotionally intelligent, with the ability to lead through trust, clarity, and empathy – even in ambiguity.

  • A builder of people and culture, passionate about coaching, growing, and empowering others to succeed.

  • Passion for games and building systems that last.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Where You'll Be

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. The team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios; however, most of our team members and stakeholders are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role, especially if based out of London.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week.

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.

Bumble is looking for a Director, International Core Markets, Integrated Marketing to lead the strategy and performance of our portfolio of established international markets.

Reporting to the VP of International Markets, you will be responsible for defining what it takes for Bumble to win across our Core Markets, protecting and strengthening our market position while identifying the next opportunities for sustainable growth, cultural relevance, and brand leadership.This is a senior leadership and people management role. You will lead and develop a team of market leaders, setting clear strategic direction while empowering them to translate Bumble's global strategy into locally relevant, insight-led market plans.

You are a strategic and empathetic leader who sets a high bar for both thinking and execution. You know how to coach teams, navigate complexity, challenge established approaches, make difficult prioritization decisions, and create an environment where people have the clarity, autonomy, and support to do their best work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the strategy and performance of Bumble's International Core Markets portfolio, establishing a clear long term vision, drives sustainable growth, and remains culturally relevant in each market.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of market leaders, setting clear direction and empowering them to own outcomes.

  • Drive alignment across the portfolio, ensuring teams stay focused on priorities, share learnings, and adapt quickly as business needs evolve.

  • Regularly assess performance across the portfolio and make deliberate choices about where to prioritize, where to invest, where to optimize.

  • Establish clear success measures across the portfolio and champion a strong culture of measurement and learning.

  • Use performance and consumer insights to continuously challenge assumptions and evolve market strategies.

  • Build strong partnerships with Global Marketing, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Partnerships, Research & Insights and other cross-functional teams, ensuring Core Market priorities are clearly represented and incorporated into broader company plans.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership, translating complexity into clear recommendations and decisions.

  • Build a high performing and inclusive team culture grounded in trust, accountability, openness, and mutual respect.

  • Act as a senior leader within the broader International organization, contributing beyond the Core Markets portfolio by sharing frameworks, market learnings, leadership practices, and strategic perspectives that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

 

KEY SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA or Master's is a plus

  • +12 years of experience in brand, integrated, or strategic marketing, ideally in consumer tech, lifestyle, or culturally-driven brands.

  • Significant experience in senior brand, integrated, strategic, or market marketing leadership roles, ideally within consumer technology, lifestyle, entertainment, or other culturally driven brands.

  • Proven experience leading multiple markets, business units, or a complex portfolio, with accountability for setting strategy, determining priorities, and driving measurable business and brand outcomes.

  • Strong people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach and develop high performing teams and managers.

  • Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move between the portfolio level view and individual market dynamics and determine what matters most.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex market challenges by synthesizing information and translating those insights into clear strategic choices.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with experience using data, measurement, and ROI frameworks to inform prioritization, investment decisions, and changes in strategy.

  • Deep understanding of integrated marketing and the role of brand, media, creators, partnerships, communications, experiential, product marketing, and growth in driving both brand and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of international marketing and the balance between global consistency and meaningful local relevance.

  • Proven ability to influence and align senior cross functional stakeholders.

  • Excellent executive communication skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast moving environment.

  • Excellent relationship building, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • You are a portfolio strategist. You can look across multiple markets, identify the few challenges and opportunities that matter most, and translate them into a clear direction for the organization.

  • You are a leader of leaders. You create clarity and set a high bar.

  • You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and dive in when necessary..

  • You are deeply consumer and culture focused but equally comfortable with business performance and data.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and can create structure and direction without waiting for every answer to be available.

  • You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across functions.

  • You are energized by change and know how to lead others through it with clarity, transparency, resilience, and optimism.
